The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore has declared the selection list for the post of Assistant Manager (Sahayak Prabandhak) under the Madhya Pradesh Government's Public Health and Medical Education Department. The result was issued on 19 August 2026 and covers the main part (87%) of the total advertised vacancies from Advertisement No. 55/2024. This article explains the selection list, category-wise post breakdown, important notes released by MPPSC, and the full list of selected candidates exactly as published in the official notification.

MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 - Direct Link

MPPSC, Indore released the Assistant Manager (Sahayak Prabandhak) Exam 2024 selection list and marks on 19 August 2026 and Only 59 out of the total 68 advertised posts are included this is the "main part" (87%) under the Public Health and Medical Education Department.Then Candidates were selected on merit, based on combined marks from the written exam (out of 450) and interview (out of 50), for a total of 500. 

Direct Link to Check MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026

MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 - Important Instructions

  1. As per Madhya Pradesh General Administration Department circular F-7-46/99/A.P./One, Bhopal, dated 7 November 2000, reserved-category candidates selected against unreserved (open) posts are those who qualify on the same standard as general category candidates, without any relaxation. Selection of reserved-category candidates on unreserved posts is done purely on merit.
  2. As per Madhya Pradesh General Administration Department circular C/3-2/97/3/One, Bhopal, dated 10 February 1997 (para 5), if sufficient women candidates are not available for women-reserved posts, such posts will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  3. The declared selection result remains subject to the final judicial outcome in SLP No. 8764/2023, SLP No. 12398/2023 (Supreme Court), and WP No. 5901/2019, WP No. 5596/2024 (High Court), along with other similar pending petitions.
  4. Out of the total 59 advertised posts under the main part (87%), 4 posts were reserved for Divyang (differently-abled) candidates - Locomotor Disability (1), Hearing Impaired (1), Visually Impaired (1), and Multiple Disability (1). Due to non-availability of eligible candidates, 3 of these posts (Hearing Impaired, Visually Impaired, Multiple Disability) remain vacant in the Divyang category. As per government rules, when Divyang posts remain vacant, an equal number of posts from the unreserved category must also be kept vacant. Accordingly, against these 3 vacant Divyang posts, 2 available unreserved (open) category posts have also been kept vacant.
  5. The selection results of candidates involved in ongoing court cases have been withheld pending the final court decision.
  6. If any computer or clerical error is found by the Commission after the result is published, MPPSC reserves the right to correct the result.

How to Check and Download KTET Result 2026 (Step by Step)

  1. Go to the official website of Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan: ktet.kerala.gov.in
  2. On the homepage, click on the "Results" tab.
  3. Click on the link that reads "K-TET EXAMINATION RESULTS FEBRUARY 2026".
  4. Select your Category from the dropdown menu.
  5. Enter your Register Number and Date of Birth (in dd/mm/yyyy format).
  6. Click the Submit button.
  7. Your KTET Result 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Download the scorecard and take a printout for future reference.

How to Check APSSB CGL Exam Final Result 2026

How to Download RBI Assistant Prelims Score Card 2026

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.

  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.

How to Download the AP District Cooperative Bank Call Letter 2026

Documents to Carry to the Exam

While the exact list is confirmed only on your individual call letter, candidates for such exams are generally required to carry:

  • Recent passport-size photographs (as specified on the call letter, if required)
  • Any additional document specifically mentioned on your call letter (e.g., category or PwD certificate, if applicable)

Important Instructions

  • Download and check your call letter well before the exam date; report any discrepancy in your name, photograph, or exam centre details to the concerned bank immediately.
  • Reach the exam venue ahead of the reporting time mentioned on the call letter late entry is typically not permitted for such online exams.
  • Carry only the permitted items; mobile phones, smartwatches, and other electronic/communication devices are usually barred inside the exam hall.
  • Follow the specific dress code, ID proof, and biometric/photo-capture instructions exactly as printed on your call letter.
  • The exact set of rules for this recruitment cycle should be read directly from the call letter and information handout issued by APCOB/DCCB, since instructions can vary slightly between recruitment cycles.

How to Download the APSC AE Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official APSC website: apsc.nic.in.
  2. Look for the notice titled "Admit Card for Assistant Engineer (Civil/Mechanical/Chemical), Advt No. 31/2025" on the homepage or under the Admit Card/Notice section.
  3. Click on the relevant admit card download link.
  4. Log in using your Application ID/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Your APSC AE Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
  6. Check all details carefully name, roll number, photograph, exam centre, and session.
  7. Download the admit card and take a clear printout for the exam day.

Details Printed on the Admit Card

The hall ticket carries the same information you submitted in your APSC AE application form. It generally includes:

  • Candidate's name and photograph
  • Roll number and application/registration number
  • Post applied for and discipline (Civil/Mechanical/Chemical)
  • Examination date and venue/centre
  • Exam-day instructions and guidelines

If any of these details appear incorrect, contact APSC through the official website or helpline immediately rather than waiting until exam day.

Important Instructions for Exam Day

  • Reach the examination centre well before the reporting time mentioned on your admit card.
  • Carry a clear printout of the admit card photocopies on plain paper without proper print quality may not be accepted.
  • Mobile phones, calculators, and other electronic gadgets are generally not allowed inside the exam hall; check your specific admit card instructions for the complete prohibited-items list.
  • Verify your exam centre address in advance and plan travel time accordingly, since APSC exam centres can be located across different towns in Assam.
  • Since this is an OMR-based screening test, carry a black or blue ballpoint pen as generally required for such exams; confirm any specific stationery instructions on your admit card.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

RBI Grade B Phase 1 Admit Card 2026 - Released

The RBI Grade B Phase 1 call letter was released on 5th June 2026, ahead of the Phase 1 examination held on 13th June 2026. The Phase 1 exam is qualifying in nature only scores from this stage are used solely to shortlist candidates for Phase 2 (Mains). Marks from Phase 1 do not contribute to the final merit list.

With Phase 1 completed, all attention now turns to the RBI Grade B Phase 2 Mains Admit Card 2026, which is expected to be released in July 2026, ahead of the Mains exam scheduled on 25th July 2026 for General posts and 26th July 2026 for DEPR/DSIM posts. RBI typically releases the Mains hall ticket approximately 7 to 10 days before the exam date, so candidates should watch the official website closely during the second week of July.

The Mains exam is a comprehensive paper that tests a candidate's knowledge of Economic and Social Issues, Finance and Management, and English Writing Skills. Unlike Phase 1, Phase 2 marks are directly counted in the final selection.

 

How to Download RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026

Downloading the RBI Grade B call letter is a straightforward process. The same steps apply for both Phase 1 (already released) and Phase 2 (upcoming). Follow the steps below to access your hall ticket from the official website.

Step 1: Visit the official RBI recruitment portal at https://opportunities.rbi.org.in/

Step 2: Look for the admit card link under the "Call Letter" section select the link for the relevant phase (Phase 1 or Phase 2).

Step 3: A login page will appear on your screen.

Step 4: Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password in the respective fields.

Step 5: Click on the Submit button. Your RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 will be displayed on the screen.

Step 6: Carefully verify all the details printed on the call letter name, roll number, exam centre, and shift timing.

Step 7: Download and take at least 2 printouts to carry on exam day.

Step 8: Read all exam day instructions mentioned on the call letter before the examination.

Candidate's Name, Roll Number and Registration Number, Photograph and Signature, Date of Birth, Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD), Post Applied For, Exam Date and Shift Timing, Reporting Time and Gate Closing Time, Exam Centre Name, Address, and Code, and Important Exam Day Instructions.

Documents to Carry to the RBI Grade B Exam Centre

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

Every candidate must bring the following on exam day:

Printed copy of the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026, 2 recent passport-size photographs, one valid original Photo ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence, and a photocopy of the same Photo ID.

Note: Individual admit cards may contain slightly different timings based on centre and shift allocation. Always follow the timing printed on your specific call letter.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

RBI Grade B Exam Day Instructions 2026

RBI has issued specific instructions that every candidate must follow on exam day. Non-compliance may result in disqualification from the examination.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Interested candidates can apply online at the official GDS Online Engagement Portal.

Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

India Post has announced 23,757 vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. The latest Annexure-Ia provides the vacancy position Circle-wise, local-language-wise and category-wise across India. The vacancies are distributed among UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS and PwBD categories.

According to the annexure, the highest number of vacancies are available in North Eastern Circle (2,614), followed by Maharashtra Circle (2,431), Tamilnadu Circle (2,118), West Bengal Circle (1,762) and Uttar Pradesh Circle (1,691). The annexure does not provide a separate vacancy breakup for BPM, ABPM and Dak Sevak posts; it gives the consolidated GDS vacancy position by Circle, language and reservation category.

Post Name Brief Role
Branch Postmaster (BPM) Overall in-charge of a single-handed Branch Post Office (B.O.) - day-to-day postal operations, IPPB transactions, marketing/promotion of Department services, mail conveyance and delivery. Must arrange own accommodation for the Branch Post Office and reside in the post village.

Indian Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for all GDS posts (BPM/ABPM/Dak Sevak) is assessed as on the date of the notification (for qualification) and the last date of application submission (for age), as detailed below.

Criterion Requirement
Educational Qualification Secondary School Examination (SSE)/10th standard pass certificate, with passing marks in Mathematics and English, from a Board recognized by the Government of India/State Governments/Union Territories. Candidates with equivalent qualification from any other board are not eligible.
Local Language Must have studied the local language (as prescribed post-wise for each Circle in Annexure-III of the notification) at least up to 10th standard from a recognized board. Special provisions apply for Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Sikkim, and Nagaland.
Other Qualifications Knowledge of computers; knowledge of cycling; and adequate means of livelihood besides the GDS allowances (to be submitted as undertakings at the time of engagement)

Note: Past experience or service of any kind is not considered for selection, as per the notification.

Indian Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

Category Initial TRCA Slab

Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM)/Dak Sevak ₹10,000/- to ₹24,470/-

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

A fee of ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) is payable by applicants for all posts notified in their choice of Division. Payment can be made online through recognized Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI (usage charges as applicable will be levied). The fee, once paid, is non-refundable, and payment must be completed strictly within the application closing date and time (up to 1700 hrs).

  • Fee-exempted categories: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants
  • Applicants who are exempted may submit their application without making any payment

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 40 years, to be determined as on the last date of submission of applications, subject to the following relaxations in the upper age limit.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

Indian Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission
  7. Pay the applicable fee (if not exempted) through the available online payment modes within 10 minutes of initiating payment
  8. Submit the application on or before the last date, and use the two-day edit/correction window (23-24 September 2026) if any corrections are needed

Indian Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate; multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited and will result in cancellation of candidature
  • Candidates are not required to upload documents with the application, only their photograph and signature; original documents are verified physically at a later stage
  • Name, Date of Birth, Father's name, and Mother's name must be entered exactly as recorded in the Class 10 (Matriculation) certificate, failing which candidature may be cancelled
  • Mobile number and email ID, once registered, cannot be modified under any circumstances
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsorily retired from Government service/GDS in the past as a penalty are barred from applying and must submit an undertaking to this effect
  • SSE marksheets of selected candidates may be verified through DigiLocker/API Setu, and candidates must give consent for this verification
  • Candidates dismissed/removed/retired from Government service in the past as a penalty are barred from applying; a false declaration will lead to termination and possible prosecution
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement
  • The Department does not make phone calls to applicants; all correspondence is through the Engaging Authority only, and applicants should be cautious of unscrupulous calls seeking personal information
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason

SSC will conduct an Open Competitive Examination to fill posts of Sub-Inspector (GD) in CAPFs, Sub-Inspector (Executive) in Delhi Police (Male/Female), and Sub-Inspector (Fire) in CISF (Male). The notice will be uploaded on the SSC website (https://ssc.gov.in) on 10.09.2026.

In brief: SSC is recruiting Sub-Inspectors for Delhi Police, CAPFs (CRPF, BSF, ITBP, CISF, SSB) and CISF Fire wing. Tentative vacancies stand at 205 (SI Exe. Delhi Police-Male), 112 (SI Exe. Delhi Police-Female), 1,467 (SI GD in CAPFs, male+female combined), and 234 (SI Fire in CISF-Male) - a combined tentative total of 1,871 posts. Graduates aged 20–25 years (18–30 for SI Fire) can apply. Online applications are open from 10.09.2026 to 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs), fee payment closes 01.10.2026. Applications are online only via ssc.gov.in or the mySSC app. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India.

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A higher qualification (B.Tech/M.Tech) in relevant fields is treated as value addition, subject to the basic diploma being held.

For the post of SI in Delhi Police, male candidates must possess a valid Driving License for LMV (Motorcycle and Car) on the date fixed for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT). Male candidates without a valid LMV licence are eligible only for SI posts in CAPFs, not Delhi Police.

  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable against any other examination.
  • Application Form Correction Window (08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026) charges: ₹200 for the first correction, ₹500 for the second correction - applicable to all candidates regardless of gender/category.

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process / Scheme of Examination

The examination consists of four mandatory stages: Paper-I, Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II, and Detailed Medical Examination (DME).

Paper-I

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25 1 Hour (sectional timer of 15 minutes per part)
II General Knowledge and General Awareness 25 25
III Quantitative Aptitude 25 25
IV English Comprehension 25 25

Paper-II

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 20 40 1 Hour (sectional timer of 20 minutes per part)
II General Knowledge and General Awareness 20 40
III Quantitative Aptitude 20 40
IV English Comprehension 100 200 1 Hour

Questions in both papers are Objective Multiple Choice Type, set in Hindi and English (Parts I–III). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Paper-I, 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Paper-II. Difficulty level of Paper-II is higher than Paper-I. NCC Certificate holders get bonus marks: 5% (NCC 'C'), 3% (NCC 'B'), 2% (NCC 'A') of maximum marks in each paper, as on the closing date of application.

Physical Standard Test (PST) – Height & Chest Norms

Height and chest requirements vary by post (SI Delhi Police / SI CAPFs / SI Fire CISF) and candidate category (general, hill areas, Scheduled Tribes, Gorkha, North-Eastern States, etc.), ranging from 154 cm to 170 cm for height depending on category and gender. Female candidates have no minimum chest measurement requirement. Weight must correspond to height for all posts. PST/PET is qualifying/eliminating in nature and does not carry marks. Relaxation in height/chest is permitted only on production of the prescribed competent-authority certificate.

Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must clear the written tests, physical standards and medical standards prescribed for direct recruits.

Medical Examination

All candidates who qualify Paper-II undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by CAPF Medical Officers. A Review Medical Examination (RME) is conducted for candidates found unfit in DME, preferably the next day; the decision of the Review Medical Board is final. DME/RME is mandatory but qualifying in nature.

Document Verification

Document Verification is conducted by the CAPFs before final result declaration, preferably alongside the DME/RME stage. Candidates must bring two passport-size colour photographs, one original valid Photo ID proof, and originals plus copies of: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, equivalence order/letter (if applicable), Caste/Category Certificate (if reserved category), Driving Licence (for Delhi Police male candidates), and Ex-Servicemen undertaking/certificates (if applicable).

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Indicative Syllabus

  • General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities/differences, space visualization, problem solving, coding-decoding, number/figural series, syllogistic reasoning, Venn diagrams, critical thinking, etc.
  • General Knowledge and General Awareness: Current events, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Number systems, percentage, ratio, averages, interest, profit & loss, time & work, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, data interpretation (graphs, histograms, pie charts).
  • English Comprehension: Error recognition, fill in the blanks, vocabulary, spellings, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, comprehension.

SSC CPO Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026

  1. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website, https://ssc.gov.in. OTR generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) will not work on the new website.
  2. Log in using your Registration Number and Password, then click 'Apply' against the SSC SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2026.
  3. Fill in the Online Application Form either on the SSC website or via the 'mySSC' mobile application (available on Store).
  4. Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication while completing OTR, which exempts them from photo/signature rejection on format grounds and from producing colour photographs/photo-ID at the exam venue.
  5. Capture a live photograph as prompted by the application (no pre-existing photo upload) with good light, plain background, no cap/mask/glasses.
  6. Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10–20 KB, approx. 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
  7. Use the Preview/Print option to check all details before final submission.
  8. Pay the application fee of ₹100 online (if not exempted) through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard, Maestro or RuPay Debit card.
  9. Submit the application before 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs) and complete fee payment before 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs).

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan.
  • The Commission neither collects vacancies nor allocates candidates state-wise, region-wise, zone-wise or city-wise for this examination.
  • Candidates should submit applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues; SSC is not responsible for failure to submit due to such reasons.
  • Applications with incomplete fee payment status will be summarily rejected.
  • After the correction window closes, no further change/correction/modification will be allowed under any circumstances.
  • Candidates have the option to choose three examination centres (in order of priority) within the same SSC region; no request for centre change will be entertained later.
  • Marks in multi-shift Computer Based Examinations will be normalized as per the Commission's published procedure.
  • There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores.
  • Success in the examination confers no right to appointment unless the Commission is satisfied, after such enquiry as considered necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all respects.
  • Candidates should retain their application forms and exam-related documents for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Information furnished in the application will be verified against original documents during Document Verification; false information will lead to summary rejection of candidature.
  • Various penalties (ranging from 1 to 7 years' debarment) apply for unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour, or possession of prohibited devices during the examination - full details are in the official notice.

SSC CHSL Selection Process

Tier-II

Tier-II is conducted in two sessions on the same day, comprising four sections: Section-I (Mathematical Abilities and Reasoning & General Intelligence), Section-II (English Language & Comprehension and General Awareness), Section-III (Computer Knowledge Test, qualifying in nature), and Section-IV (Skill Test/Typing Test for DEO and LDC/JSA posts respectively). It is mandatory to qualify all sections of Tier-II. There is negative marking of 1 mark per wrong answer in Sections I and II.

Educational Qualification and Experience

Candidates must satisfy either of the following qualification and experience combinations:

Option 1: Master’s Degree with Experience

  • One year of experience in handling stores and maintaining store accounts.

Option 2: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma with Experience

Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Salary

The Foreman of Stores post carries Pay Level 6 under the applicable Central Government pay structure.

Nature of Duties

  • Acting as custodian of the storehouse.
  • Supervising staff working under the Foreman of Stores.
  • Assisting senior officers in the audit of ledgers and folios.
  • Coordinating with the audit authority.
  • Managing inventory and disposing of scrap materials.
  • Supervising the receipt and issue of stores in the warehouse.
  • Ensuring effective material management.
  • Performing other duties connected with stores and service requirements.

Selection Process

The Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores selection process includes the following stages:

  1. Scrutiny of applications
  2. Shortlisting of eligible candidates
  3. Document verification
  4. Written examination
  5. Preparation of merit list based on written examination marks

Admit cards will be sent by post to shortlisted candidates using the self-addressed stamped envelope enclosed with the application. The list of shortlisted candidates will also be published on the Indian Coast Guard website.

Written Examination Pattern

Subject Questions Marks
Mathematics 15 15
Mental Ability and Reasoning 15 15
General Awareness 15 15
English 15 15
Questions Related to the Profession 20 20
Total 80 80

 

Examination Mode Pen-and-paper examination

Written Examination Syllabus

Mathematics

Mathematical simplification, ratio and proportion, interest, profit and loss, percentage, work and time, speed and distance, simple mensuration, average, median and mode.

English

Passages, prepositions, sentence correction, active and passive voice, direct and indirect speech, verbs, tense, non-finites, punctuation, phrasal verbs, synonyms, antonyms, difficult words, adjectives and compound prepositions.

General Awareness

Indian geography, soil, rivers, mountains, ports, culture, religion, freedom movement, national facts, heritage, arts, history, defence, awards, discoveries, diseases, nutrition, current affairs, languages, capitals, currencies, abbreviations, personalities, sports and general science.

Reasoning

Spatial and numerical reasoning, associative ability, logical reasoning, sequences, spelling unscrambling, coding and decoding, seating arrangements, blood relations, inequalities, decision-making and input-output.

Professional Knowledge

Supply-chain management, receipt and storage procedures, requisitioning and distribution of materials, stores equipment, maintenance of ledgers and connected documents.

  • Bhubaneswar

About Central Power Research Institute (CPRI)

Central Power Research Institute (CPRI) is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, engaged in research and development in generation, transmission, distribution and operation of electricity supply systems. CPRI acts as an apex body for applied research in electrical power engineering and serves as an independent authority for testing and certification of power equipment. Its head office is in Bangalore, with units at Bhopal, Hyderabad, Nagpur, Nashik, Noida, Kolkata, Guwahati and Raipur.

Online Application Starting Date 19 September 2026 at 9:00 AM
Online Application Closing Date 18 October 2026 at 11:59 PM

Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Vacancy 2026

Railway Unit Pay Level Number of Posts
Southern Railway Level 2 2
Southern Railway Level 1 12
Integral Coach Factory Level 2 1
Integral Coach Factory Level 1 2
Total 17

The 12 Southern Railway Level 1 posts are distributed at two posts each among Chennai, Tiruchchirappalli, Madurai, Palakkad, Thiruvananthapuram and Salem divisions.

The advertised posts are open to all eligible candidates irrespective of community. There is no separate reservation for any community under the Scouts and Guides Quota.

Educational Qualification

Level 2 Posts

Candidates must possess any one of the following qualifications:

  • Passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination with at least 50% marks in aggregate; or
  • Passed Matriculation from a recognized board with a Course Completed Act Apprenticeship for technician categories; or
  • Passed Matriculation from a recognized board with an ITI qualification approved by NCVT for technician categories.

The requirement of 50% marks in Class 12 is not applicable to SC, ST and ex-servicemen candidates or candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12.

Level 1 Posts

Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications:

  • Class 10 pass; or
  • ITI or an equivalent qualification; or
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate granted by NCVT; or
  • Class 10 with ITI; or
  • Class 10 with a National Apprenticeship Certificate granted by NCVT.

Scouts and Guides Qualification

Candidates must satisfy all the following Scouts and Guides requirements:

  • Must be a President’s Scout, Guide, Rover or Ranger, or a Himalayan Wood Badge holder in any section.
  • Must have been an active member of a Scouts organization for the last five years.
  • Must possess a Certificate of Activeness in the prescribed format.
  • Must have attended two events at the National Level or All Indian Railway level.
  • Must have attended two events at the State Level.

Age Limit as on 1 January 2027

Post Level UR OBC SC/ST
Level 2 18 to 30 years 18 to 33 years 18 to 35 years
Level 1 18 to 33 years 18 to 36 years 18 to 38 years

Additional Age Relaxation

  • Serving Railway employees with the prescribed continuous or broken service may receive relaxation up to 40 years for UR, 43 years for OBC and 45 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated but not remarried may receive relaxation up to 35 years for UR, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ST.
  • Eligible Jammu and Kashmir domiciled candidates may receive five years of relaxation.
  • Eligible Casual Administrative Office staff may receive age relaxation according to the prescribed conditions.
  • Ex-servicemen will receive relaxation according to applicable service and category rules.

Age Limit for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities

Post Level UR OBC SC/ST
Level 2 40 years 43 years 45 years
Level 1 43 years 46 years 48 years

Application Fee

Candidate Category Application Fee Refund Provision
All candidates except the concessional categories listed below Rs. 500 Rs. 400 will be refunded after deducting applicable bank charges to eligible candidates who appear in the examination.
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes Rs. 250 The fee will be refunded after deducting applicable bank charges to eligible candidates who appear in the examination.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway. Candidates who apply separately for both Level 1 and Level 2 must pay the applicable fee separately for each application.

Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Selection Process

The recruitment carries a total of 100 marks and consists of the following stages:

Selection Component Maximum Marks
Written Test/Hybrid Examination 60 marks
Marks for Scouts and Guides certificates 40 marks
Total 100 marks

The Level 1 and Level 2 examinations will be conducted separately.

Written Examination Pattern

Examination Mode Written Test/Hybrid CBT-cum-Physical Examination
Duration 1 hour
Objective Questions 40 questions carrying one mark each
Essay Question One essay-type question carrying 20 marks
Total Marks 60
Negative Marking One-third mark deducted for every incorrect objective answer
Question Paper Language Hindi or English

Minimum Qualifying Marks

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage
UR 40%
OBC, SC and ST 30%

Marks for Scouts and Guides Certificates

Activity or Certificate Maximum Marks
Participation or service in National Events or National Jamboree 10 marks
Participation or service in State Events or Rallies 10 marks
Specialized Scouts and Guides course organized at National, State or All Indian Railways level 10 marks
Participation in District Rallies 10 marks
Total 40 marks

Medical Examination

Candidates recommended for appointment must satisfy the prescribed medical classification of Bee Two and above for posts identified by Southern Railway or Integral Coach Factory.

Documents to Upload

  • Scanned copies of Scouts and Guides qualification certificates.
  • Certificate of Activeness and details of attended events.
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets.
  • Proof of date of birth.
  • Community certificate, where applicable.
  • Age-relaxation certificate, where applicable.
  • Fee-exemption certificate, where applicable.
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph in Scouts or Guides uniform.
  • Scanned signature.

Photograph and Signature Requirements

  • The photograph should be recent and not older than three months.
  • It must show the candidate in Scouts or Guides uniform with a clear front-facing view.
  • The photograph should be in JPG or JPEG format at 100 DPI.
  • The prescribed photograph size is 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm.
  • The file size should be between 50 KB and 100 KB.
  • The signature should be made on white paper in black ink.
  • The signature file should be in JPG or JPEG format at 100 DPI.
  • The signature file size should be between 10 KB and 40 KB.

How to Apply for Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the RRC Chennai website at www.rrcmas.in.
  2. Open Employment Notice No. RRC-01/S&G/2026-27.
  3. Read the detailed eligibility conditions and application instructions.
  4. Complete the online registration using an active mobile number and email address.
  5. Select Level 1 or Level 2 and enter the required details.
  6. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates.
  7. Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment gateway.
  8. Review the application carefully and submit it before 18 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  9. Save or print the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates may apply for both Level 1 and Level 2 if they satisfy the respective eligibility requirements.
  • A separate application and examination fee must be submitted for each level.
  • Candidates should maintain an active personal mobile number and email address throughout the recruitment process.
  • Applications with incomplete information, an invalid photograph or an invalid signature may be rejected.
  • Original certificates must be produced during document verification.
  • Admission at every recruitment stage will be provisional and subject to eligibility verification.
  • Canvassing, impersonation or submission of false documents will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates should regularly check the RRC Chennai website for examination and recruitment updates.

KVIC Young Professional Eligibility

Candidates must possess a full-time postgraduate degree in the relevant field from a UGC-recognized university, recognized deemed university or an AICTE-approved institution.

KVIC Advisor Eligibility

IFCI Post-wise Experience Requirements

Associate Director

Candidates should have at least 15 years of experience in Public Sector Banks, the financial sector, consulting or dealing with government departments and ministries. Relevant experience should include credit appraisal, financial modelling, portfolio monitoring and recovery.

Associate Director - Estates, Services and Administration

Candidates should have at least 15 years of experience in estate management, property and building maintenance, operation and maintenance of commercial or residential buildings, civil works, electrical installations, vendor management, procurement and administrative functions.

Senior Associate

Candidates should have at least six years of post-qualification experience in the financial sector, consulting, credit appraisal, project or financial modelling, portfolio monitoring or recovery actions.

Senior Associate - Technical, Advanced Chemistry Cell

Experience should include Advanced Chemistry Cells, energy storage, battery manufacturing, battery research, electric mobility or similar emerging technologies.

Senior Associate - Credit Risk Management

Candidates should have at least six years of experience in banks, financial institutions, NBFCs or consulting firms in credit risk management, risk modelling, risk policy or Expected Credit Loss computation.

Senior Associate - Credit Monitoring and Recovery

Candidates should have experience in stressed asset resolution, corporate credit, project finance, appraisal, monitoring or recovery in a bank, financial institution, NBFC or consulting firm.

Senior Associate - Estates, Services and Administration

Candidates should have experience in property management, building maintenance, civil works, mechanical or electrical systems, vendor management, GeM procurement, administration and security management.

Senior Associate - Human Resources

Candidates should have experience in recruitment, performance management, compensation, employee relations, disciplinary matters, labour laws or HR policy implementation.

Senior Associate - Technical, Electronic Component Manufacturing Scheme

Candidates should have experience in electronics or electronic component manufacturing, capital equipment analysis, technical appraisal, plant and machinery verification or consultancy services for the electronics sector.

Senior Associate - Technical, Chemical and Petrochemical Sector

Candidates should have experience in chemical, petrochemical, specialty chemical or process-industry projects, technical appraisal, project implementation, infrastructure monitoring or environmental compliance.

Senior Associate - Technical, Infrastructure Projects

Candidates should have experience in infrastructure development, industrial parks, large-scale projects, EPC, PMC, infrastructure consultancy, project appraisal, planning, implementation or monitoring.

The engagement will initially be for three years. The contract may be extended further by mutual agreement between IFCI and the selected candidate.

The selected candidate must execute an indemnity bond with a surety to serve IFCI for at least one year. A candidate resigning before completing one year will have to pay IFCI Rs.1 lakh, in addition to serving the prescribed notice period or paying salary in lieu of notice.

  1. Initial scrutiny of online Resume or Biodata
  2. Shortlisting based on qualification and experience
  3. Personal or online interview
  4. Document verification

IFCI may restrict the number of candidates called for the interview by considering qualifications and experience higher than the minimum eligibility requirements.

The interview may be conducted at New Delhi or through online mode, depending on the decision of IFCI.

  2. Open the Careers section of the website.
  3. Find Advertisement No. IFCI/2026-27/02.
  4. Read the detailed advertisement carefully.
  5. Download the prescribed CV format available in the Careers section.
  6. Complete the online application form.
  7. Upload the Resume or Biodata only in the prescribed format.

Candidates should include the following information in their CV:

  • Total experience
  • Current CTC
  • Expected CTC
  • Notice period
  • Current location
  • Date of birth

Documents Required from Government Employees

Candidates working in Central Government, State Government, semi-government organisations, autonomous bodies, CPSEs, PSUs or PSEs must provide the following documents if shortlisted for the interview:

  • Recruiting body: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI)

  • Total vacancies: 15
  • Eligible candidates: B.Tech/B.E holders in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/Telecommunications/Computer Science/IT, or Bachelor's degree holders in Arts/Commerce/Administration etc., who completed their qualification in June 2021 or thereafter

STPI Apprentice Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026

STPI Apprentice Trainee eligibility 2026 is based on educational qualification in one of two discipline groups, along with the prescribed age limit.

STPI Apprentice Trainee Stipend 2026

Selected Apprentice Trainees will receive a monthly stipend based on their qualification:

  • B.E/B.Tech candidates: Rs. 15,000/- per month
  • Bachelor in Arts/Commerce/Administration, etc.: Rs. 12,300/- per month

The Screening-cum-Selection Committee may offer a higher stipend, up to Rs. 20,000/- per month, based on the candidate's performance in the interview. The stipend payable to apprentices will be facilitated through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism - the admissible Government share of stipend will be directly credited to the apprentices' bank accounts through the NATS portal after successful registration on the NATS Portal for DBT.

STPI Apprentice Trainee Selection Process 2026

How to Apply for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026

STPI Apprentice Trainee Apply Online process requires mandatory prior registration on the NATS Portal, followed by application through STPI's own web portal. Only online applications will be accepted; offline applications are not considered.

  1. Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in before applying through STPI's portal - this is mandatory.
  2. On the NATS Portal, click the "Student" section, then "Enroll" under the Student section, confirm you meet the eligibility criteria, and proceed to the Enrollment Form.
  3. Fill in personal information: name, date of birth, gender, email, mobile number, and create a login ID and password. Enter your Aadhaar number and other required identification details.
  4. Fill in educational details: highest qualification (Diploma/Graduate), institution name, year of passing, and percentage/CGPA.
  5. Fill in communication and bank details: present and permanent address, and bank account details (account number, IFSC code, bank name) for stipend processing.
  6. Review all details carefully and submit the NATS registration form; a unique Student Enrolment ID will be generated and sent to your registered email ID.
  7. Visit STPI's Web Portal under the Career Section at www.stpi.in and fill the online application for Apprentice Trainee, mentioning your NATS Enrolment ID in STPI's Online application module.
  8. Submit the completed application on or before 30.09.2026; applications received after the last date will not be considered.

IRCTC SCZ Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Hospitality Monitors Tourism Monitors
Organization Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC), South Central Zone

Walk-in interview dates Hospitality Monitors - 05.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 08.10.2026 (Hyderabad); Tourism Monitors - 06.10.2026 (Bhubaneswar) and 09.10.2026 (Hyderabad)

IRCTC SCZ Important Dates – Walk-in Interview Schedule

Candidates must appear on the scheduled date and time at the applicable venue with the duly filled application form, original documents, attested copies, and photographs.

Post Address Date Time
Hospitality Monitors Institute of Hotel Management (IHM), Near Indian Overseas Bank, V.S.S. Nagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751007 05.10.2026 10:30 hrs to 17:30 hrs
Institute of Hotel Management (IHM), F-Row, Vidya Nagar, DD Colony, Hyderabad, Telangana 500007 08.10.2026 10:30 hrs to 17:30 hrs
Tourism Monitors IRCTC – Regional Office, Gate-1, Tower-1, Ground Floor, NBCC Imperia, Near New Govt. Colony, Press Square, Bhubaneswar – 751017 06.10.2026 10:30 hrs to 17:30 hrs
IRCTC Ltd, 1st Floor, Oxford Plaza, Sarojini Devi Road, Secunderabad-500003 09.10.2026 10:30 hrs to 17:30 hrs

Note: In case of extension of the interview date, candidates will have to arrange their own stay and food. Any corrigendum/clarification to either notification (including date and place of interview) will be uploaded only on the IRCTC website (www.irctc.com); no separate press coverage will be given in newspapers. Tourism Monitors candidates can appear for interview at only one of the two convenient venues.

IRCTC SCZ Vacancy Details 2026

Post Number of Posts Reservation
Hospitality Monitors 22 posts (includes 4 OBC backlog vacancies against previous Notification No. 2025/IRCTC/HRD/SCZ/Rectt.-I/ Hospitality Monitors (Fixed Term Contract) dated 01.03.2026) As per Government of India policy
Tourism Monitors 6 posts SC – 15%, ST – 7.5%, OBC-NCL – 27%, PwBD – 4%, EWS – 10%, Ex-Servicemen – 10%

The number of vacancies to be filled (including the Reserve Panel) may increase or decrease depending on IRCTC's requirement at the time of engagement.

IRCTC SCZ Eligibility Criteria 2026

IRCTC Hospitality Monitors Qualification and Experience

Educational Qualification (any one) Upper Age Limit (as on 01.09.2026) Experience
(1) Full time B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration from a Central or State institute of Hotel Management (CIHM/SIHM/PIHM) affiliated to NCHM&CT/UGC/AICTE/Government of India
(2) BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts) from Indian Culinary Institutes under Ministry of Tourism
(3) B.Sc. Hotel Management and Catering Science from Government-recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government
(4) M.B.A (Tourism and Hotel Management) from Government-recognized Universities affiliated to UGC/AICTE/Government of India/State Government		 Upto 28 years* No experience
28 years to 30 years* 1 year experience
30 years to 35 years* 2 years' experience

*35 years for UR. Age relaxation is given to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Serviceman applicants as per Government guidelines: upper age is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST applicants, 3 years for OBC applicants, and 10 years for PwBD applicants. For Ex-Servicemen, relaxation is up to the extent of service rendered in defence plus 3 years.

IRCTC Tourism Monitors Qualification and Experience

Educational Qualification Experience Remuneration
3-Years Bachelor degree in Tourism; OR 3-Years bachelor degree in any stream + 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism Minimum 1 year working experience in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms Rs. 30,000/- per month (incl. statutory deductions) and other allowances as applicable
3-years Bachelor Degree in any stream + 2-years Post Graduation Degree/Diploma in Travel & Tourism Minimum 2 years working experience in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms Rs. 35,000/- per month (incl. statutory deductions) and other allowances as applicable

Upper age limit as on 01.09.2026 for Tourism Monitors is 35 years for UR. Age relaxation is given to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Serviceman applicants as per Government guidelines: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PwBD applicants. For Ex-Servicemen, relaxation is up to the extent of service rendered in defence plus 3 years.

IRCTC SCZ Remuneration and Allowances 2026

Hospitality Monitors Remuneration and Allowances

  • CTC: Rs. 30,000/- per month (incl. statutory deductions) and other allowances as applicable
  • Daily Allowance: Rs. 350/- per day for on-duty on-board in train(s) - 100% for more than 12 hours, 70% for 6 to 12 hours, and 30% for less than 6 hours
  • Lodging Charges: Rs. 240/- only if night stay is involved at an outstation
  • National Holiday Allowance (NHA): Rs. 384/- per National Holiday (if worked)
  • Medical Insurance: Rs. 1,400/- per month (up to 35 years), Rs. 2,000/- per month (36–50 years); reimbursement subject to submission of valid documents

Tourism Monitors Remuneration and Allowances

  • CTC: Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month (incl. statutory deductions), based on qualification/experience
  • Daily Allowance: Rs. 350/- per day for on-duty on-board in train(s) - 100% for more than 12 hours, 70% for 6 to 12 hours, and 30% for less than 6 hours
  • Lodging Charges: Rs. 240/- only if night stay is involved at an outstation
  • National Holiday Allowance (NHA): Rs. 384/- per National Holiday (if worked)
  • Medical Insurance: Rs. 800/- per month; reimbursable on submission of valid documents

IRCTC SCZ Scope of Work 2026

Hospitality Monitors – Scope of Work

  1. Responsible for the supervision and monitoring of food production, quality & services in nominated mobile catering units (Vande Bharat Trains/Mail/Express trains/TSVs)/Tourist Trains/Bharat Gaurav Trains, etc.
  2. Responsible for the supervision and monitoring of food production and quality in nominated static catering units/Base Kitchens/Cluster Kitchens, as well as kitchens supplying meals to Vande Bharat Trains.
  3. Ensuring the working of equipment and proper pest control, and ensuring proper cleaning of the mini pantry and pantry by service provider staff before completion of each round trip.
  4. The nature of duty will also require movement in trains (all over India).
  5. Ensuring compliance with company policies and standard hospitality procedures/practices.
  6. Ensuring proper manpower & materials for nominated mobile/static catering units.
  7. Resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management.
  8. Collecting feedback, its analysis, and course correction.
  9. Ensuring statutory compliance/regulations as applicable.
  10. Supervising & educating staff in efficient upkeep of equipment and devices.
  11. Coordinating with various departments, offices, and business partners.

The list is only tentative, and candidates will be assigned duties from time to time as per extant guidelines.

Tourism Monitors – Scope of Work

  • Manning the 'Bharat Gaurav Rakes' and supporting all other Tourism related activities.
  • Marketing and back-end support of various tour packages, handling air/rail ticketing of corporate travel and walk-in clients.
  • Ensuring compliance with company policies and standard procedures/practices.
  • Resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management.
  • Collecting feedback, its analysis, and course correction.
  • Ensuring statutory compliance/regulations as applicable.
  • Supervising, training & educating staff in efficient services.
  • Coordinating with various departments, Railways, other offices, and business partners.

IRCTC SCZ Selection Process 2026

Selection for both Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors is through Walk-in Interview, following the same broad process:

  1. Candidates must fill in the application form (attached with the respective notification), completing it in all respects.
  2. The completed application form must be submitted at the venue of the interview for verification, along with original documents, one set of attested copies of requisite documents, and two recent passport-size photographs.
  3. An interview will be conducted, and candidates will be shortlisted based on their credentials and performance in the personal interview.
  4. The offer of engagement will be issued to suitable candidates in order of merit and based on the number of vacancies, subject to verification of antecedents.
  5. In addition to the shortlisted candidates (22 for Hospitality Monitors, including 4 OBC backlog vacancies; 6 for Tourism Monitors), an equal number of candidates will be placed on a Reserve Panel.

Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to candidates being found fit in the medical test prescribed for the post. For Hospitality Monitors, candidates will have to undergo a pre-employment medical examination, and continuation in service will also be subject to remaining medically fit. For Tourism Monitors, engagement of selected candidates is subject to being medically fit as prescribed by IRCTC.

How to Apply for IRCTC SCZ Hospitality Monitors and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026

IRCTC SCZ Apply process is through walk-in interview; there is no online application portal for these posts.

  1. Download and fill the Proforma/Application Form attached with the relevant notification (Hospitality Monitors or Tourism Monitors) on www.irctc.com.
  2. Complete all fields: personal details, category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS/Ex.SM), present and permanent address, contact details, date of birth and age (as on 01.09.2026), gender, marital status, Aadhaar number, educational qualification details (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post Graduation), post-qualification experience, and languages known.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of proof of educational qualification (certificates and marksheets), proof of experience (if any), proof of date of birth (10th certificate), and proof of category (OBC-NCL candidates must submit the certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India).
  4. Affix a recent photograph and sign the declaration confirming that the information provided is true and correct.
  5. Carry the completed application form, along with original documents, one set of attested copies, and two recent passport-size photographs, to the applicable walk-in interview venue on the scheduled date and time.
  6. Tourism Monitors candidates should note that they can appear for interview at only one of the two convenient venues.

IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions

  • This engagement is purely on a fixed-term/contractual basis and will not entitle any candidate to claim regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.
  • The engagement will remain provisional till satisfactory verification of antecedents by the appropriate authorities. If any information furnished is found false or incorrect, or if material information is wilfully suppressed, the contract is liable to be terminated without notice or compensation.
  • The contract may be terminated by giving one month's notice by either side. For Hospitality Monitors, if performance during the contract period is not found satisfactory, the contract may be terminated by providing 15 days' notice; for Tourism Monitors, an unsatisfactory-performance contract may be terminated without any notice.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs may apply through proper channel, or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, or submit a proper relieving letter from their present employer in the event of selection in IRCTC.
  • IRCTC reserves the right to cancel/amend the advertisement and/or the selection process at any time without prior notice.
  • The number of vacancies to be filled (including the Reserve Panel) may increase or decrease depending on IRCTC's requirement at the time of engagement (and, for Hospitality Monitors, as per CO guidelines issued from time to time).
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post applied for. If it is found at any stage of selection, or even after engagement, that a candidate has furnished false or incorrect information or does not fulfil the criteria, their candidature/services will be summarily terminated.
  • Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- in the form of a Demand Draft. For Hospitality Monitors, contractual staff must complete a minimum service period of one year, failing which the security deposit amount is liable to be forfeited.
  • No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the walk-in interview.
  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and preparation of reports is desirable, along with the ability to solve problems and make rational decisions.
  • Any corrigendum/clarification to either notification (including date and place of interview) will be uploaded only on www.irctc.com; no separate press coverage will be given in newspapers.

DAV Staff Recruitment Selection Process

Selection under DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 takes place in two main stages:

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT): A centralised online exam conducted all over India as per the datesheet prepared by DAVCMC.
  2. Demo-cum-Interview (Phase 3): Conducted separately by individual DAV schools, as and when advertised. Only candidates who clear both the demo and interview are offered employment. Schools may charge a nominal handling fee at this stage.

DAV CBT 2027-28 Exam Pattern

The CBT will be a computer-based exam of a total of 1.5 hours (90 minutes), comprising two papers held one after the other in the same slot. Note: this is last year's pattern; the pattern for CBT 2027-28 may change and will be notified in November 2026.

Shift Reporting Time Entry Timings CBT Timings
Morning 7.30 am 7.45 – 8.15 am 8.30 – 10.00 am
Afternoon 10.30 am 10.45 – 11.15 am 11.30 am – 1.00 pm

Paper 2 Main Subject (of post applied for) 70 minutes 40 MCQs English (except Regional languages, Hindi & Sanskrit)

  • Original government-issued photo ID (PAN card, Driving Licence, Voter ID, Passport, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar, etc.) matching the name and photo on the Admit Card

Prohibited items inside the exam centre include stationery items (printed/written material, calculators, pen drives, log tables, electronic pens/scanners), communication devices (smartwatch, mobile phone, Bluetooth devices, earphones, camera, etc.), wallets, goggles, handbags/pouches, and any opened or packed food item (except for diabetic candidates).

How to Apply for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026

  1. Check advertisements for vacancies in different DAV schools/zones in national and regional newspapers (16 to 22 September 2026).
  2. Visit the official DAV Recruitment website: davrecruit.davcmc.in.
  3. Fill the online CBT Registration Form before 08 October 2026 and submit it as "Form Ready for Verification" (partial submission; the form remains editable at this stage).
  4. Print the form and take it to the nearest DAV Verification Centre for verification of original testimonials (25 September to 16 October 2026). The school will verify and mark it "Verified and Approved for Payment"; after this, the form is locked.
  5. Pay the CBT fee of Rs. 300/- online, within 7 days of approval, on the DAV Recruitment website only.
  6. Wait for the datesheet, choose exam centre preference online (first-come-first-serve basis), and download the Admit Card once issued (November 2026).
  7. Appear for the CBT as per the assigned date, shift, and centre (December 2026).

DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Online applications for DAV Staff Recruitment 2026 are accepted only through the official portal: davrecruit.davcmc.in. Candidates must use their own Registered Mobile Number (RMN) and personal email ID throughout the process - the same details are needed later for verification, Admit Card download, and the Provisional Eligibility Card (PEC). Each candidate may apply for one post only, and duplicate applications will not be accepted.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released two Examination Notices, both dated 16.09.2026, for Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE): the Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026, and the Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2022, 2023 & 2024. Both examinations share the same application window and examination dates.

  • Recruiting body: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
  • Examinations: Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026; Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE, 2022, 2023 & 2024
  • Eligible candidates: Serving government employees eligible under the respective LDCE rules (this is a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, restricted to eligible in-service candidates as per DoPT Rules published in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026)
  • Application start date: 16.09.2026
  • Application last date: 06.10.2026 (till 06:00 PM)

UPSC Section Officers Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

UPSC Stenographers  Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026 Overview

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has notified two Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations on the same date. The Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026 (F.No.9/02/2026-E.IB) will be held for recruitment to Section Officers' Grade posts across several cadre-controlling services. The Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE covers the examination years 2022, 2023 & 2024. Both examinations will be conducted on 12th and 13th December 2026, and applications for both are accepted through the Commission's common online application portal.

Particulars Details

File No. (Section Officers' Exam) F.No.9/02/2026-E.IB

UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE Important Dates

Both the Section Officers' Grade-B LDCE and the Stenographers' Grade-B/Grade-I LDCE share the same notification date, application window, and examination dates.

Event Date
Date of Notification of Examination 16.09.2026

Helpdesk operational period 16.09.2026 to 06.10.2026 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM, working days)

UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026 – Categories and Vacancy Details

For the Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026, the notification lists the services/categories for which recruitment is to be made, but explicitly states that the number of vacancies in various categories has not yet been finalized by the concerned Cadre Controlling Authorities (CCAs), and therefore no vacancy figures are indicated in the notice at this stage.

Category Service
Category I Section Officers' Grade of the Central Secretariat Service
Category II Section Officers' Grade of the General Cadre of the Indian Foreign Service, Branch 'B'
Category III Section Officers' Grade of the Railway Board Secretariat Service
Category VIII Section Officers' Grade of the Intelligence Bureau
Category X Section Officers in Armed Forces Headquarters Civil Service
Category XI Assistant Director/Section Officers/Manager Grade-'I' in Employees' State Insurance Corporation

Candidates must clearly indicate in their application the Category for which they are competing. For Category II (Section Officers' Grade of the General Cadre of IFS, Branch 'B'), appointment/seniority will be subject to any judicial directive/judgement bearing on recruitment/seniority in that cadre. For Category III (Section Officers' Grade of RBSS), the result for 2026 would be provisional, subject to the outcome of O.A. No.215/2022 before the Central Administrative Tribunal, Principal Bench, New Delhi, and revision of the seniority list of Assistant Section Officers' (ASOs') Grade of RBSS, if any.

For the Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE, 2022, 2023 & 2024, category-wise services and vacancy details are not specified in the provided notification excerpt.

UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE Eligibility Criteria 2026

Both examinations are Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations, meaning eligibility is restricted to serving government employees who meet the conditions prescribed for their respective service/cadre. The Section Officers' Grade-B LDCE will be held in accordance with the Rules published by the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) in the Gazette of India dated 16th September 2026. Final selection under different categories will be decided based on guidelines issued by DoPT vide O.M. No. 36012/2016/2019-Estt (Res.) dated 12.04.2022, subject to the final outcome of Civil Appeal No.629 of 2022 arising out of SLP (C) No.30621/2011.

Specific qualification, minimum service, and grade-pay eligibility conditions for candidates are not detailed in the provided notification excerpt. Candidates should refer to the detailed Rules published in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026, and the full notification on https://upsc.gov.in, before applying, as the prescribed eligibility conditions cannot be relaxed.
