Closing Date for Post Under UT of Ladakh 09.10.2026
Interview Date Not specified in the notification; will be intimated separately to shortlisted candidates by email

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Post-wise Vacancy Details

Vacancy numbers, reservation positions, and PwBD suitability/reservation are as notified against each post.

S.No. Post Name Department/Organisation No. of Vacancies
1 Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy) Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare 4 (UR-01, EWS-01, SC-02)
2 Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine) Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare 60 (UR-13, EWS-10, OBC-30, SC-05, ST-02; PwBD-03 backlog)
3 Assistant Editor Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines 2 (UR-01, SC-01; PwBD-01 backlog)
4 Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) – Anaesthesiology New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) 1 (ST-01)
5 Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) – Paediatrics New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) 1 (EWS-01)
6 Assistant Public Prosecutor Directorate of Prosecution, Home Dept., Govt. of NCT of Delhi 140 (UR-50, EWS-14, OBC-37, SC-30, ST-09; PwBD-08)
7 Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer Law & Justice Dept., Administration of UT of Ladakh 4 (ST-04; PwBD-01)

Total vacancies across all seven posts: 212. Several posts carry PwBD-reserved (backlog) vacancies in addition to the general reservation position; posts not reserved for PwBD but identified as "suitable" allow PwBD candidates to apply and be considered on general merit.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Eligibility Criteria (Post-wise)

1. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 45 years for SC.
  • Qualification: Post-Graduate degree in Anatomy (e.g., MS/MD/DNB Anatomy, or MBBS with MSc Anatomy, or MSc Medical Anatomy with PhD/DSc) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

2. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 43 years for OBC; 45 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised MBBS degree plus Postgraduate degree in Medicine/General Medicine (MD/DNB) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree. (Note: experience as General Duty Medical Officer/Medical Officer is not counted.)
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

3. Assistant Editor (Indian Bureau of Mines)

  • Age: 30 years for UR; 35 years for SC; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Journalism/Mass Communication, OR Bachelor's degree with Economics/Statistics/English plus a 1-year diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience editing and publishing in a publishing house, newspaper, news agency, publicity organisation, or government organisation.
  • Desirable: Master's degree in Mass Communication/Journalism/Economics/Statistics/English; experience with publishing software (PageMaker, MS Office, CorelDraw, QuarkXPress, Photoshop).
  • Pay Scale: Level-07 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Nagpur, Maharashtra (service liability anywhere in India).

4. Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) – Anaesthesiology (NDMC)

  • Age: 50 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification (MBBS-equivalent) plus PG degree/diploma in Anaesthesiology (MD/MS Anaesthesiology, DA, FFARCS, or equivalent).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

5. Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) – Paediatrics (NDMC)

  • Age: 45 years for EWS; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification plus PG degree/diploma in Paediatrics (MD Paediatrics, or Diploma Paed./DCH).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

6. Assistant Public Prosecutor (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)

  • Age: 35 years for UR/EWS; 38 years for OBC; 40 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. Contractual employees get a one-time relaxation up to 5 years (subject to conditions).
  • Qualification: Degree in Law from a recognised University/Institute.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience at the bar.
  • Desirable: Experience as a government advocate.
  • Pay Scale: Level-10 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: National Capital Territory of Delhi.
  • Mandatory induction training of at least 2 weeks for direct recruits.

7. Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer (UT of Ladakh)

  • Age: 40 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Law (Professional or Integrated) from a university established by law in India, with 2 years' actual practice at the bar, certified by the Principal District & Sessions Judge or Registrar General of the concerned High Court/Supreme Court.
  • Pay Scale: Level-8 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: UT of Ladakh.
  • Domicile requirement: Recruitment is exclusive to Domiciles of the UT of Ladakh under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment – Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules, 2025. A valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory.
  • Reservation governed by the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act, 2004 (as extended/amended for Ladakh), covering ST, SC, Residents of Areas Adjoining the Actual Line of Control (ALC), EWS, and PwBD.

For all posts, the qualifications shown are relaxable at UPSC's discretion for otherwise well-qualified candidates, and experience requirements may be relaxed for SC/ST candidates if sufficient qualified candidates from these communities are not available.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Application Fee

  • Fee payable: ₹25 (Rupees Twenty-Five only), via Visa/MasterCard/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI or internet banking.
  • Women candidates, and candidates belonging to SC, ST or Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) of any community, are exempted from fee payment.
  • No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS/Unreserved male candidates - they must pay the full fee.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, with no representation entertained.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination/selection.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Age Relaxation & Concessions

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years' relaxation; OBC candidates: 3 years' relaxation (for posts reserved for them).
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years' relaxation (cumulative with SC/ST/OBC relaxation where applicable), subject to maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs): 5 years' relaxation, subject to minimum 6 months' continuous service after attestation as on closing date.
  • Central/UT Government servants: up to 5 years' relaxation (10 years for SC/ST, 8 years for OBC in posts reserved for them), subject to 3 years' continuous service in an allied cadre.
  • Scribe facility is available for specified categories of PwBD candidates in Recruitment Tests, subject to conditions.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Selection Process

  • Recruitment is "by Selection" - primarily interview-based. Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Where the number of applications is large, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: Desirable Qualifications, higher educational qualification, higher/relevant experience, or by holding a Recruitment Test (RT).
  • Minimum level of suitability in interview (out of 100 marks): UR – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PH – 40 marks.
  • Where a Recruitment Test (RT) precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both the RT and interview stages.
  • Recruitment Test/Combined Recruitment Test (if held) will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (for the Ladakh post: Leh, Kargil, Srinagar, and Delhi).
  • Shortlisted candidates must send self-attested copies of documents/certificates as and when demanded by the Commission.
  • Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection. Appointment orders are issued by the Government after final selection.
  • UPSC may grant higher initial pay to candidates adjudged meritorious in the interview.

How to Apply for UPSC Advt No. 11/2026

  1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in and complete Account Creation, Universal Registration (to generate a Universal Registration Number, URN), and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these three modules are common to all UPSC recruitments and can be filled anytime.
  2. Fill the fourth, post/vacancy-specific module during the notified application window for this advertisement.
  3. Capture a live photograph as prompted while filling the CAF (in addition to uploading a photograph), ensuring it meets the Commission's photo/signature guidelines.
  4. Sign three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink and upload the scanned signature.
  5. Upload supporting documents for each claim (date of birth, caste, educational qualification, experience, disability, desirable qualification, age relaxation, etc.) separately, in PDF format, in the prescribed proforma where applicable.
  6. Use Aadhaar as your ID document where possible for smoother verification; alternatively use Voter Card/PAN/Passport/Driving Licence.
  7. Review all details carefully - applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction/alteration/modification is allowed after submission.
  8. Submit the application before the closing date: 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs) for all posts except the Ladakh post, or 09.10.2026 for the Ladakh post.
  9. Take a printout of the finally submitted application for your records - do not send it to UPSC by post; bring it only if called for interview, along with original documents.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee (pre-1962), or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with intent to permanently settle in India - subject to eligibility certificate requirements for the latter categories.
  • The date for determining eligibility in every respect is the closing date for submission of the online application.
  • All correspondence from the Commission will be through the registered email ID only - candidates must furnish a correct, active email address.
  • PwBD candidates can apply for posts identified as "suitable" even if not reserved for them, and will be considered on general standard of merit; reservation/relaxation benefits apply only where the disability is 40% or more.
  • Candidates already in regular Central/State Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department in writing about applying.
  • Furnishing false particulars, suppressing material information, tampering with documents, impersonation, or using unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible debarment from future UPSC examinations/selections and Central Government employment.
  • Candidates called for interview will get Commission's contribution towards travel, restricted to Second/Sleeper Class train fare (Mail/Express), paid via NEFT/bank details submitted at the interview.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, programmable devices, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Government strives for a gender-balanced workforce; women candidates are encouraged to apply.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination (CGSE), 2027, inviting online applications for 127 tentative vacancies of Geologist, Geophysicist, Chemist, and related Group A/B posts in the Geological Survey of India (Ministry of Mines) and the Central Ground Water Board (Ministry of Jal Shakti). Eligible candidates aged 21 to 32 years, holding a relevant Master's degree in Geology, Geophysics, Chemistry, or Hydrogeology, can apply online through the Commission's portal from 02-09-2026 to 22-09-2026 (6:00 PM). Selection is a three-stage process: the Preliminary Examination on 10-01-2027, the Main Examination on 19th and 20th June 2027, and a Personality Test/Interview. This notification covers applications for the Preliminary Examination only.

The notification was issued as Examination Notice No. 01/2027-GEOL and File No. 04/01/2026-E.I(B), dated 02-09-2026, based on the Rules of the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination, 2027 notified by the Ministry of Mines in the Gazette of India dated 02-09-2026.

  • Notification: UPSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • Apply Online: Apply Now
  • Commission's Website: https://upsc.gov.in
  • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

UPSC CGSE 2027 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Authority Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Examination Name Combined Geo-Scientist Examination (CGSE), 2027
Notification Number Examination Notice No. 01/2027-GEOL
Posts Geologist, Geophysicist, Chemist (Group A); Assistant Geologist, Assistant Geophysicist, Assistant Chemist (Group B) in GSI; Scientist 'B' and Assistant-level posts in CGWB
Total Vacancies 127 (tentative): 111 in GSI (Category-I) + 16 in CGWB (Category-II)
Application Mode Online only
Application Fee ₹200 (Female/SC/ST/PwBD exempted)
Last Date to Apply 22-09-2026, up to 6:00 PM
Preliminary Exam Date 10-01-2027
Main Exam Date 19th and 20th June, 2027
Job Location Geological Survey of India / Central Ground Water Board, across India
Official Website https://upsc.gov.in

Also Read: SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1,748 Junior Engineer Posts

UPSC CGSE 2027 Important Dates

Event Date
Date of notification 02-09-2026
Start of online application 02-09-2026
Last date for filling online application 22-09-2026, up to 6:00 PM
Helpline operational period 02-09-2026 to 22-09-2026, 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM (working days)
Combined Geo-Scientist (Preliminary) Examination 10-01-2027
Combined Geo-Scientist (Main) Examination 19-06-2027 and 20-06-2027

This notification is for the Preliminary Examination only. Candidates who qualify will separately be permitted to appear for the Main Examination.

UPSC CGSE Vacancy 2027 – Category-Wise Details

UPSC has notified 127 tentative vacancies across two categories. The Commission states these numbers are liable to alteration, and appointments will initially be made on a temporary basis.

Category-I: Geological Survey of India (Ministry of Mines)

Post Vacancies
Geologist, Group A 29
Geophysicist, Group A 0
Chemist, Group A 7
Assistant Geologist, Group B 34
Assistant Geophysicist, Group B 35
Assistant Chemist, Group B 6
Category-I Total 111

Of these, 8 vacancies are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability: 1 Geologist [OH(OA/OL)], 1 Chemist [HH], 2 Assistant Geologist [1-OH(OA/OL), 1-HH], 3 Assistant Geophysicist [HH], and 1 Assistant Chemist [HH].

Category-II: Central Ground Water Board (Ministry of Jal Shakti)

Post Vacancies
Scientist 'B' (Hydrogeology), Group A 5
Scientist 'B' (Chemical), Group A 1
Scientist 'B' (Geophysics), Group A 1
Assistant Hydrogeologist, Group B 7
Assistant Chemist, Group B 1
Assistant Geophysicist, Group B 1
Category-II Total 16

Of these, 2 vacancies are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability: 1 Scientist 'B' (Hydrogeology) [HH] and 1 Assistant Hydrogeologist [LDCP]. A candidate may apply for one or both categories using a single application and a single fee payment.

UPSC CGSE 2027 Examination Centres

The Preliminary Examination will be held at 21 centres: Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Chennai, Cuttack, Delhi, Dispur, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Jammu, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Patna, Prayagraj (Allahabad), Shillong, Shimla, and Thiruvananthapuram. Centre allotment is on a first-apply-first-allot basis, with a ceiling per centre except at Chennai, Dispur, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad; candidates are advised to apply early to secure their preferred centre. The Main Examination will be held at 9 centres: Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Hyderabad, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, and Shimla.

UPSC CGSE Eligibility Criteria 2027

Nationality: A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, specified East African countries, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate for the latter categories).

UPSC CGSE Educational Qualification

Post Minimum Qualification
Geologist / Assistant Geologist Master's degree in Geological Science, Geology, Applied Geology, Geo-Exploration, Mineral Exploration, Engineering Geology, Marine Geology, Earth Science and Resource Management, Oceanography and Coastal Areas Studies, Petroleum Geosciences, or Geochemistry
Geophysicist / Assistant Geophysicist / Scientist 'B' (Geophysics) M.Sc. in Physics, Applied Physics, Geophysics, Exploration Geophysics, Applied Geophysics, or Marine Geophysics (as applicable)
Chemist / Assistant Chemist / Scientist 'B' (Chemical) M.Sc. in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Hydro-Chemistry, or Industrial Chemistry
Scientist 'B' (Hydrogeology) / Assistant Hydrogeologist Master's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, Marine Geology, or Hydrogeology

All qualifying degrees must be from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature, an institution established by an Act of Parliament, or a deemed university under the UGC Act, 1956. A Master's degree means a postgraduate degree of minimum two years' duration after graduation, whether integrated or otherwise. Candidates awaiting their qualifying result may also apply, subject to producing proof of passing before the Personality Test.

Also Read:India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 23757 BPM, ABPM & Dak Sevak Posts (Schedule-II, July)

UPSC CGSE Age Limit

  • A candidate must have attained 21 years and must not have attained 32 years as on 1 January 2027 - i.e., born not earlier than 2 January 1995 and not later than 1 January 2006
  • Upper age relaxable up to 5 years for Government servants employed in GSI or CGWB applying for the corresponding post
  • Upper age relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, 3 years for disabled Defence Services personnel, 5 years for Ex-servicemen, and 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

UPSC CGSE Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay a fee of ₹200, through net banking or Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI. Female candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Persons with Benchmark Disability are exempted from the fee. OBC and EWS candidates are required to pay the full prescribed fee. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

UPSC CGSE 2027 Exam Pattern

Stage Type Marks
Stage-I: Preliminary Examination Objective Type (two papers per stream) 400
Stage-II: Main Examination Conventional/Descriptive Type (three papers per stream) 600
Stage-III: Personality Test/Interview - 200

Marks secured in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations count towards the final merit. The Preliminary Examination for Stream-I (Geology/Hydrogeology) has Paper-I: General Studies (2 hours, 100 marks) and Paper-II: Geology/Hydrogeology (2 hours, 300 marks). Similar stream-specific papers apply for Geophysics and Chemistry streams.

UPSC CGSE Selection Process

Selection proceeds through three successive stages: the Preliminary Examination (Stage-I) for shortlisting to the Main Examination; the Main Examination (Stage-II) for shortlisting to the Personality Test; and the Personality Test/Interview (Stage-III). Final selection for GSI and CGWB posts is strictly by merit position in each category, candidate preference, and number of vacancies.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar Card (strongly advised as primary ID) or Voter Card/PAN Card/Passport/Driving Licence
  • Matriculation/Secondary School certificate (for date of birth)
  • Educational qualification certificates/mark sheets for the relevant Master's degree
  • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), where applicable, in the prescribed format and validity window
  • Photograph and signature, per the Commission's upload specifications

How to Apply Online for UPSC CGSE 2027

  1. Visit the Commission's Online Application Portal at https://upsconline.nic.in.
  2. Create an account and complete Universal Registration to generate a Universal Registration Number (URN), which is common to all UPSC examinations for life.
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF), which is shared across UPSC exams.
  4. Fill the fourth, examination-specific module for CGSE 2027, including fee payment and choice of examination centre.
  5. Upload your photograph, live photo capture, and signature as per the Commission's instructions.
  6. Pay the application fee online, if applicable, and submit the application by 22-09-2026, 6:00 PM.

Applications can be submitted online only, at https://upsconline.nic.in. No other mode of submission is allowed, and no withdrawal, correction, or alteration is permitted after submission - except for the one-time URN profile edit facility, which does not affect already-submitted applications.

UPSC CGSE 2027 – Important Instructions

  • Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, and similar electronic equipment are strictly banned at the examination venue, even in switched-off mode.
  • Entry to the examination venue closes 30 minutes before the commencement of each session; no entry is allowed after closure under any circumstances.
  • All candidates must undergo mandatory face authentication and identity verification at the venue.
  • Only black ball pens are permitted for writing and marking the OMR sheet; pencils and ink pens are not allowed.
  • There is negative marking for wrong answers in the Objective Type papers.
  • e-Admit Cards will be issued on the Commission's website only, on the last working day of the week preceding the exam; no admit card will be sent by post.
  • Eligible candidates may make representations on the question papers and provisional answer keys online, within 5 days from the 3rd day of the exam to 6:00 PM of the 7th day; no representation by email, post, or hand is accepted.

SSC JE Qualification

Essential educational qualifications differ by organization and post. Broadly:

  • JE (Civil): Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute; or a three-year diploma in Civil Engineering plus relevant work experience (requirement varies by organization).
  • JE (Electrical) / JE (Mechanical) / JE (Electrical & Mechanical): Degree or diploma in the relevant Electrical/Mechanical/Automobile engineering discipline from a recognized university/institute, with experience required in some organizations.
  • JE (Telecom): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical Communications, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or Instrumentation.
  • Scientific Assistant (IMD): Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics as one of the subjects, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering/Instrumentation/Information Technology/Telecommunication Engineering/Communication Engineering.

Because the exact qualification differs organization by organization (for example, CPWD requires a diploma while BRO accepts a degree or diploma-plus-experience), candidates should check the qualification listed against their target organization in the official notice before applying. Qualifications obtained through Open and Distance Learning (ODL)/online mode in restricted disciplines such as Engineering are not accepted unless specifically permitted under applicable UGC regulations or judicial orders.

  • The fee payment deadline is 23.09.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Fee once paid is not refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination.
  • Applications with unpaid or incomplete fee status are summarily rejected.

SSC JE Salary

Selected candidates will be appointed to Group 'B' posts in Pay Level-6 of the Pay Matrix under the 7th Central Pay Commission, with a pay scale of ₹35,400 – ₹112,400. Actual in-hand salary will also include applicable allowances (such as DA, HRA and TA) as per the rules of the respective recruiting organization, which are not detailed in this notice.

SSC JE Selection Process

Selection for SSC JE 2026 is based on the following stages:

  1. Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) – Qualifying in nature. Covers General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 questions/50 marks), General Awareness (50 questions/50 marks), and the relevant engineering/technical subject based on the post applied for (100 questions/100 marks). Total duration is 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for a scribe). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.
  2. Paper-II (Computer Based Examination) – For candidates shortlisted from Paper-I. Covers the relevant engineering/technical subject in depth (100 questions/300 marks) in 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates). Negative marking of 1 mark applies for each wrong answer.
  3. Document Verification (DV) – Provisionally selected candidates must produce original certificates (educational qualification, category, age proof, experience, etc.) for verification by the concerned user department/organization.
  4. Physical Standards and Medical Examination – Applicable specifically for posts under organizations such as Border Roads Organisation (BRO)/GREF, as detailed in the relevant annexure of the notice.

Separate merit lists are prepared for JE (Civil), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), Scientific Assistant (IMD), and JE (Telecom). Both papers consist of objective-type, multiple-choice questions set in Hindi and English.

Check SSC JE Syllabus 2026 Here

How to Apply for SSC JE Recruitment 2026

  1. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website (ssc.gov.in). An OTR already generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid on the new site.
  2. Log in and fill the online application form for the JE Examination 2026, either via the SSC website or the "mySSC" mobile app.
  3. Upload photograph and signature, or opt for Aadhaar-based authentication, which exempts candidates from certain photo/signature format rejections.
  4. Select your organization, post, and relevant subject/stream as per your educational qualification - this choice cannot be changed later.
  5. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) using BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or a Visa/MasterCard/Maestro/RuPay debit card.
  6. Preview and submit the form, and save/print a copy for your records.

SSC JE Apply Online

The SSC JE apply online link is active on the official SSC website (ssc.gov.in) from 02.09.2026 to 22.09.2026. Candidates should complete their application well before the closing date, since SSC has stated it will not be responsible for candidates unable to submit due to heavy website traffic near the deadline.

AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Remuneration & Allowances

As per DoPT OM F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, a fixed monthly remuneration is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. This fixed amount remains unchanged for the entire term of the contract – there is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period.

Allowances (per DoPT OM dated 09.12.2020)

  • HRA: Not admissible.
  • Transport Allowance: A fixed amount for commuting between residence and place of work, not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement; this amount also remains unchanged during the appointment. TA/DA on official tour, if any, is admissible as per the consultant’s entitlement at the time of retirement.
  • TDS will be deducted at source from the remuneration.

AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Selection Process

  • There is no written examination. Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and are shortlisted will be called for Application Verification followed by an Interview.
  • Final selection is based on merit ranking of the interview alone.
  • The schedule for verification/interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only on their registered email ID.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the application verification/interview, for joining the assignment, on its completion, or at any point during the engagement process.
  • Mere submission of an application, or meeting the eligibility criteria, does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection.
  • Prior to commencement of the contract, AAI may require the selected consultant to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate (equivalent to defence medical standards) from a recognized physician, duly certified by the ATS In-Charge of the Joint User Defence Airfield where deployment is likely.

How to Apply for AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026

  1. Download and fill the Application Form in the prescribed format (Annexure-1 to the Advertisement).
  2. Attach self-attested copies of all necessary supporting documents, proof of Educational Qualification and Work Experience.
  3. Combine the duly filled application and all supporting documents into a single PDF file not exceeding 5 MB.
  4. Email the combined PDF to [email protected] on or before 1 October 2026.
Important: Applications through any mode other than the specified email will NOT be accepted. Ensure the email ID given in the application remains active, as all call letters and further information will be sent by email only.

Documents Required

  • Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-1), including: name, date of birth, age as on 01.10.2026, father’s name, gender, service branch (Army/Navy/Air Force/Coast Guard), date of joining and date of discharge from the Armed Forces, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email ID
  • Details of Educational/Professional Qualification – exam/qualification, university/college, month & year of passing, percentage of marks
  • Details of Work Experience – organization/department, designation with level, period (from-to), total experience, nature of work (attach a separate sheet if required)
  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents substantiating educational qualification and work experience claims
  • A recent photograph, and the candidate’s signature with the declaration on the application form

Important Conditions

Period of Engagement

  • Initial engagement is for 1 year only, extendable by 1 more year at a time; the total cumulative period cannot exceed 5 years, and no extension can take the consultant beyond 55 years of age.
  • The engagement is full-time; consultants will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the engagement period.
  • A formal Contract/Agreement specifying the terms and conditions will be drawn up between the selected consultant and AAI.

Charter of Duties

Consultants will assist and support Air Traffic Control (ATC) operations at the concerned Joint User Defence Airfield, including ATC/SMC operations, watch extension, and other ATC-related activities as assigned by the ATS In-Charge.

Leave Provisions

  • Leave is allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service.
  • Consultants must mark attendance daily at their place of reporting/engagement.
  • Unavailed leave in a calendar year is neither carried forward nor encashed into the next year.
  • Absence beyond admissible leave and notified holidays results in a proportionate deduction from the consultancy remuneration.
  • AAI may terminate the engagement if the consultant remains absent without intimation to the supervisory authority for more than 3 working days.

Other Conditions

  • In case of death, injury or illness of the consultant attributable to the performance of services under the contract, AAI shall not be responsible for any compensation.
  • False or insufficient information, or lack of proof to ascertain eligibility, will lead to summary rejection of candidature at any stage, with appropriate action as deemed fit.
  • AAI reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received, and to cancel/modify/withdraw/postpone this engagement notice.
  • AAI may terminate a consultant’s services at any time by giving 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu of the notice period, and AAI management’s decision is final. A consultant may similarly seek termination by giving AAI 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Documents and Scanned Images Required

Document Specification
Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm, colour, white/light background, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG
Signature Black ink on white paper, not in capital letters, 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB, JPG/JPEG
Left Thumb Impression Black or blue ink on white paper, 240×240 pixels at 200 DPI (3cm × 3cm), 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG
Handwritten Declaration In English, black ink on white paper, 800×400 pixels at 200 DPI (10cm × 5cm), 50–100 KB, JPG/JPEG
Mark Sheets, Degree Certificates, Experience/Relieving Letter, Caste Certificate (if applicable) PDF format, 20–500 KB

Important Instructions

  • Candidates should be willing to serve anywhere in India; selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • OBC caste certificates must specifically contain the non-creamy layer clause and must be valid (issued within one year prior to) the last date of applying.
  • Deputy Managers must execute a personal bond of ₹3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or appear in the CIBIL defaulter database are not eligible to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai, with courts/tribunals in Mumbai having sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the recruitment process, including the number of vacancies, at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected may use a scribe at their own cost and arrangement, subject to the Bank's stipulated scribe guidelines, and will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination if registered for it in advance.

Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

Bank of India (BOI), a leading Public Sector Bank with its Head Office in Mumbai, has released a notification for the recruitment of Officers in various Specialist streams up to Scale IV. Under Project No. 2026-27/02 dated 01.08.2026, BOI is inviting applications for 205 vacancies across 48 distinct posts ranging from Officer (Scale I) to Chief Manager (Scale IV). Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science/IT, Law, Fire Engineering, and Civil Engineering can apply online between 10.09.2026 and 25.09.2026.

In brief: BOI is recruiting for IT and specialist officer roles spanning Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Information Security, DevSecOps, Data Engineering, Database Administration, Law Officer, Fire Officer, Security Officer, and Civil Engineer, among others. Eligible Indian citizens (and other nationalities specified in the notice) meeting the post-specific qualification and experience criteria as on 01.08.2026 can apply online through the official BOI website. The application mode is online only, and postings will be anywhere in India.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks, 15th cycle (CRP RRBs-XV), inviting online applications for Group "A" Officer (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in India. IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online registration opens on 1 September 2026 and closes on 21 September 2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for Officer Scale-I, II (seven specialisations), III, and Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts, with an indicative 13,706 vacancies spread across 28 RRBs covering nearly every state and union territory of India. Graduates in any discipline (with specific additional qualifications for certain Officer Scale-II specialist roles) between 18 and 40 years of age (depending on the post) can apply online only, from 1 September 2026 to 21 September 2026, at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in.

IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details

IBPS RRB Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

Nationality: a candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently in India, or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Educational qualification (as on the last date of online registration, i.e. 21.09.2026) varies by post:

Post Essential Educational Qualification Post-Qualification Experience
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent; proficiency in the local language prescribed by the participating RRB; working knowledge of computers is desirable Not required
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference to candidates with a degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, IT, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy; local language proficiency required Not required
Officer Scale-II - General Banking Officer Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds 2 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Information Technology Officer Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Communication/Computer Science/IT or equivalent, minimum 50% aggregate marks 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Chartered Accountant Certified Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 1 year as a Chartered Accountant
Officer Scale-II - Law Officer Degree in Law from a recognised university, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years as an advocate, or as a Law Officer in a bank/financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Treasury Manager Chartered Accountant, or MBA in Finance from a recognised university/institution 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Marketing Officer MBA in Marketing from a recognised university 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Agricultural Officer Bachelor's degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Dairy/Animal Husbandry/Forestry/Veterinary Science/Agricultural Engineering/Pisciculture, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the relevant field
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds Minimum 5 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution

Candidates awarded CGPA/OGPA must convert it to a percentage as per their university's own conversion criteria, and the result for the qualifying degree must have been declared on or before 21.09.2026.

Post Age Limit

Age relaxation is available as follows: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (non-creamy layer), 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), and additional relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and (for Office Assistant only) widows, divorced women, and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one other applicable category.

IBPS RRB Salary & Exam Pattern

Salary: Not specified in the notification.

Exam pattern: The online examination structure differs by post and stage.

Post Stage Sections Total Marks Duration
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Preliminary Reasoning, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 80 45 minutes
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Main Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 200 120 minutes
Officer Scale-III (Single-level exam) Single Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, Financial Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Data Interpretation 200 120 minutes

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the objective tests; unattempted questions are not penalised. Officer Scale-II candidates sit for a single-level examination (structure not itemised separately in the notification excerpt reviewed here beyond the general pattern above).

Also read: IBPS RRB Clerk Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026: Download PDF Here

IBPS RRB Selection Process

  • Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Provisional Allotment (based on Main Exam marks and actual vacancies reported by the RRB).
  • Officer Scale-I: Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Officer Scale-II & III: Single-level online exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Interview is out of 100 marks; minimum qualifying marks are 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates).
  • The relative weightage for Officer posts is 80% online exam and 20% interview.
  • Interviews for Officer posts are coordinated by the Nodal Regional Rural Bank with the assistance of NABARD and IBPS.

How to Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in, and open the "CRP for RRBs" link on the home page.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICERS (Scale-I, II and III)" or "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICE ASSISTANTS (Multipurpose)", as applicable.
  3. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by SMS/email).
  4. Log back in using the provisional registration number and password to complete the rest of the form.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, and your Class 10 (SSC/SSLC) certificate, plus any category/disability certificates applicable to you, as per the scanning specifications in Annexure-III.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online.
  7. Candidates applying for both Office Assistant and an Officer post, or reconsidering their choice of Officer scale, must register and pay separately for each post.
  8. Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a Government of India-owned Public Sector General Insurance Company, has released the UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 notification for the post of Administrative Officer (Scale I). The recruitment covers two disciplines - Generalists and Hindi Officers - with a combined 225 provisional vacancies. Online registration for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 begins on 8th September 2026 and closes on 28th September 2026.

Eligible Indian citizens (and specified categories under Nationality rules) who meet the age and qualification criteria as on 30.06.2026 can apply online through the official website, uiic.co.in. Below is a complete breakdown of UIIC AO vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, application fee, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

  • UIIC Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a Government of India Undertaking
Post Name Administrative Officer (Scale I) – Generalists & Hindi Officers
Reference Number HO:HRM:REC:AO:1:2026
Notification Date 07.09.2026
Total Vacancies 225 (200 Generalists + 25 Hindi Officers) – provisional
Application Mode Online only
Age Limit (as on 30.06.2026) 21 to 30 years
Application Start Date 8th September 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 28th September 2026
Job Location Offices across India; vacancies substantially in Western and Southern Zones
Official Website uiic.co.in

UIIC AO Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration Commences 8th September 2026
Last Date of Online Registration 28th September 2026
Last Date for Payment of Application Fee/Service Charges 28th September 2026
Downloading of Call Letters for Online Examinations 7 days prior to each examination (tentative)
Tier I: Preliminary Examination (Online Objective Test) 22nd October 2026 (tentative)
Tier II: Main Examination (Online Objective Test + Descriptive Test) 30th November 2026 (tentative)

UIIC AO Vacancy Details

UIIC has announced 225 provisional vacancies for Administrative Officer (Scale I) across two disciplines. The category-wise breakup, including the 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), is given below. Note that these numbers are provisional and may vary as per the notification.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Administrative Officer – Generalists 200 (UR-68, OBC-62, EWS-22, SC-30, ST-18; PwBD horizontal: VI-2, HI-2, OC-4, MD/ID-3)
2 Administrative Officer – Hindi Officers 25 (UR-11, OBC-7, EWS-2, SC-4, ST-1; PwBD horizontal: VI-1)

A candidate can apply for either Generalists or Hindi Officers, but not both. Multiple registrations or appearances will lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates currently serving as Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in UIIC are not eligible to apply.

Also Read: Bank of Baroda SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1100 Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst Posts

UIIC AO Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the Nationality/Citizenship condition as on the date of application. A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the last four categories must hold an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

UIIC AO Qualification

The minimum educational qualification must have been obtained on or before 30.06.2026 from a recognised university or institute, approved by UGC/AICTE, through the 10+2+3 pattern or an equivalent system. Working knowledge of computers is mandatory for all candidates.

Discipline Minimum Educational Qualification
Generalists Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any discipline (including Engineering, Arts, Science, Commerce, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) from a recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)
Hindi Officers Master’s Degree from a recognised university with Hindi and English in any of the specified combinations (as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination) at the degree level, with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)

Where only CGPA/OGPA/SGPA is awarded, candidates must produce a conversion certificate from the university; a fraction such as 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.

UIIC AO Age Limit

As on 30.06.2026, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 30 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 30.06.1996 and not later than 30.06.2005 (both dates inclusive). Upper age relaxation is available as follows, subject to a cumulative cap of 45 years.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 Years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 Years
Ex-servicemen (with at least 5 years military service) 5 Years
Defence personnel disabled in operations 3 Years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) 9 Years
Existing confirmed employees of Public Sector General Insurance Companies (incl. GIC & Agriculture Insurance Company of India Ltd.) 8 Years

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

UIIC AO Application Fee

The application fee/service charges are non-refundable under any circumstances, once paid.

Category of Applicant Amount (Non-Refundable)
All applicants other than SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC ₹1,000/- (application fee including service charges) + GST as applicable
SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC Application fee: Nil. ₹250/- (service charges only) + GST as applicable

Also Read: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Offline for 178 Pharmacist, Executive and More Posts

UIIC AO Salary

Selected candidates will draw basic pay in the scale of ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, along with other admissible allowances. In addition to emoluments, the Company provides Gratuity, LTS, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and National Pension System (NPS), with leased accommodation extended as per Company rules. Gross pay is approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres.

Selected candidates will serve a probation period of one year (extendable at the Company’s discretion) and must pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India during probation. Candidates must also execute a guarantee bond to serve the Company for a minimum of five years, including the probation period; early resignation attracts liquidated damages plus a ₹35,000 onboarding and integration cost.

UIIC AO Selection Process

Selection for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview.

  • Tier I – Preliminary Examination (Qualifying, 100 marks, 60 minutes): English Language (30 questions/30 marks), Reasoning (35/35), Quantitative Aptitude (35/35).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Generalists: Objective Test of 250 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness with special reference to the Financial Sector, and Computer Knowledge – 200 questions, 150 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 30 marks (Letter Writing and Essay, 30 minutes).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Hindi Officers: Objective Test of 200 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Professional Knowledge of Hindi/English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge – 150 questions, 120 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 50 marks (English/Hindi essay, letter writing, and translation, 60 minutes).
  • Interview: Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for interview, up to three times the vacancies in the respective category/discipline.

For Generalists, the final merit list is prepared using Main Examination Objective Test marks and Interview marks in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary and Descriptive Test marks are not counted for merit. For Hindi Officers, the Main Examination (Objective + Descriptive) and Interview marks are considered in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary Examination marks are not counted for merit. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in the objective tests.

Documents Required

  • Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, colour, light background)
  • Scanned signature in black ink (not in capital letters)
  • Scanned left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration in English, in the candidate’s own handwriting, as per the prescribed format
  • Valid Call Letter and original Photo Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter’s Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, or similar accepted ID) at the time of examination and interview
  • Category/community, age, and educational qualification certificates, as applicable, at the time of interview

Ration cards and Learner’s Driving Licences are not accepted as valid photo ID proof.

How to Apply for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Recruitment section on the UIIC official website and click on “Apply Online”.
  2. Choose “Click here for New Registration” and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, using the “Save and Next” option to complete it in stages.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
  5. Preview the completed application form and verify all details carefully.
  6. Click “Complete Registration” only after confirming all details are correct, as no changes are permitted afterward.
  7. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the applicable application fee/service charges online.
  8. Click “Submit” and take a printout of the system-generated application form and payment receipt for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • No change of category, discipline, or application data will be permitted after registration is complete.
  • Candidates should apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • The initial posting period is a minimum of five years, and requests for transfer to a preferred location will not be entertained.
  • Candidates must keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process, as all official communication will be sent there.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the courts in Chennai.

Detailed Job Descriptions 

Field Collection Officer / Collection FOS (DRA Certified)

Supports Bank of Baroda's receivable management and recovery operations through field visits and customer interactions for timely recovery of overdue payments, in compliance with RBI guidelines and the Fair Practices Code. Responsibilities include visiting allocated customers, negotiating repayment plans, resolving queries, maintaining records, escalating disputed cases, and achieving monthly productivity/recovery/quality targets. Possession of a two-wheeler and valid driving licence is required. Job location: PAN India.

Digital Onboarding Specialist (Part-Time)

Assists walk-in branch customers in adopting the Bank's digital banking ecosystem — mobile banking, internet banking, UPI, and digital applications for FDs, RDs, loans, insurance, investment products, and credit cards. Also supports digital service requests (KYC updates, cheque books, nominee updates, etc.). This is a part-time role (6 hours, 10:30 AM–4:30 PM), open to freshers. Job location: PAN India.

Aadhaar Operator (Part-Time)

Performs Aadhaar enrolment and update processes, captures biometric data (fingerprints, iris scan, photograph), verifies identity documents, enters demographic details as per UIDAI standards, and maintains data privacy. Requires an active NSEIT certificate and basic computer/typing skills. Job location: PAN India, including AEC centres and enrolment camps.

Executive – Debit Card Operations / ATM-Reconciliation-Complaints

The job description document details a related "Executive – Debit Card Operations (Issuance/Reconciliation/Disputes)" profile under Digital Banking at Vadodara, matching the notice's separate Debit Card Operations role (10 posts). No separate detailed JD was found for the "Executive – ATM/Reconciliation/Complaints/Debit Cards" role (40 posts, Alkapuri, Vadodara) listed in the notice.

Sales Officer/ASM/RSM – Loan Sales

Covers day-to-day sales management for Home/Auto/Education/Tractor loans, including empanelling and developing sales teams, achieving sales/cross-sell targets through SO/SSO and dealer channels, managing client relationships, and ensuring compliance with NHB/RBI regulations. A Graduate degree is mandatory; minimum 3 years of relevant experience (ASM level) or 1–3 years (Direct Sales Executive level). Job location: PAN India, including Mumbai, Bengaluru, NCR, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Baroda.

Tele-Collection / Collections Executive

Manages large volumes of outbound calls for overdue payment collection, following communication scripts, identifying customer needs, and meeting individual/team collection targets. DRA certification is required; candidates should not be pursuing further studies. Experience required: minimum 0–5 years (varies by seniority — Executive/Senior Executive, Assistant Manager, or Trainer-level roles have differing experience requirements as detailed in the source JDs). Locations: GIFT City-Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Bangalore, and Manjalpur-Vadodara depending on the specific sub-role.

MIS Analyst / Contact Center MIS Executive

Manages data for client reporting, dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly), campaign and dialer data management, automation of reports, and statistical/performance feedback to operations. Requires graduation and advanced MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI). Job location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

Procurement Manager / Assistant Manager – Procurement

Executes procurement and tendering processes (e-Tendering via GeM, open/limited tenders, rate contracts), ensures compliance with GFR 2017, CVC guidelines, and internal procurement policy, supports vendor management, and maintains procurement MIS. Minimum Graduate required, MBA (Finance/Operations/Supply Chain) preferred, with minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Job location: Gift City, Gandhinagar.

Desktop Support Analyst / IT Support Engineer

Provides Level 1 & Level 2 technical support for hardware, software, and network issues; manages IT tickets, endpoint/asset management, Active Directory/Microsoft 365 administration, and network troubleshooting. Requires graduation plus CompTIA A+ or equivalent and Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (or equivalent) certifications, with minimum 3+ years of experience.

Exim Bank Business Development Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection for the post of Business Development Officer is based on shortlisting followed by a personal interview; there is no written examination specified in the notification.

  1. Application Screening: The Bank will check whether applicants meet all the prescribed eligibility criteria relating to qualification, experience, and age.
  2. Shortlisting for Interview: Candidates will be shortlisted for interviews in the ratio of 1:10. If more than 10 eligible candidates are found for the available posts, a shortlist will be drawn based on the percentage score obtained at the post-graduation examination.
  3. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview at the Bank's office in Mumbai or New Delhi. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed; no correspondence will be made with ineligible or non-shortlisted candidates.

The Bank may, at its discretion, relax the eligibility criteria relating to experience, age, and essential qualifications in the event of a limited response to the advertisement or an insufficient number of eligible candidates.

Required Documents and Aadhaar Verification Rules

The notice lays out specific Aadhaar-related requirements that candidates must complete before appearing for the exam:

  • Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication of candidates will be carried out at the exam center before entry into the exam hall.
  • Candidates must bring their original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar.
  • If Aadhaar authentication has not already been completed, candidates are advised to log in with their credentials at www.rrbapply.gov.in and complete Aadhaar verification to ensure smooth entry into the exam center.
  • Candidates including those who already verified Aadhaar during application submission must ensure their Aadhaar remains in an unlocked condition in the UIDAI system before coming to the exam centre, to avoid inconvenience during registration and exam-day processes.
  • The Aadhaar card should be updated with:
    • Correct name
    • Date of birth (as per Class 10th Certificate)
    • Latest photograph
    • Updated biometrics (if not updated after reaching the age of 15 years)
    • Correct address
    • Father's name

📄 Complete Details & Notification

RRB Technician Application Status 2026 has been released by the Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) on 10th September 2026, with the status-check link going live from 11th September 2026 on the official portal rrbapply.gov.in. The update applies to candidates who applied under CEN No. 02/2026 for a total of 6,557 Technician Grade-I (Signal) and Technician Grade-III vacancies. Candidates can log in with their registered email ID/mobile number and password to check whether their form is Provisionally Accepted, Provisionally Accepted with Conditions, or Rejected.

Particulars Details
Recruitment Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
Notification Number CEN No. 02/2026
Post Names Technician Grade-I (Signal) & Technician Grade-III
Total Vacancies 6,557
Application Status Release Date 10th September 2026

Also Read: RRB Technician Exam Date 2026

How to Check RRB Technician Application Status 2026

  1. Visit the official website: rrbapply.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "Login" option on the homepage.
  3. Enter your registered mobile number/email ID and password.
  4. Click the "Submit/Login" button.
  5. Locate and click the link that reads "CEN 02/2026 (Technician)".
  6. Your RRB Technician Application Status 2026 will be displayed on the screen.
  7. Download the page or take a printout for future reference.

Login Details Required to Check Status

  • Registered email ID or mobile number
  • Password created at the time of application/registration

What Details Appear on the RRB Technician Application Status 2026

  • Candidate name and basic identification details as per the application form
  • Registered mobile number/email ID used for login and communication
  • CEN number and post details CEN 02/2026 (Technician Grade-I/Grade-III), along with the specific RRB zone applied to
  • Current status of the form Provisionally Accepted, Provisionally Accepted with Conditions, or Rejected
  • Reason for rejection, where applicable for example, an invalid photo/signature, incomplete form, ineligibility, or fee not paid

Also Read: MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 1 AEO Admit Card 2026

Important Instructions

  • Candidature at this stage is purely provisional, subject to further document verification and eligibility checks at later stages.
  • Only candidates whose status shows "Provisionally Accepted" (or "Provisionally Accepted with Conditions") will be permitted to appear in the RRB Technician CBT.
  • If your application is rejected, read the stated reason carefully; in most RRB recruitment cycles, an online objection/rectification window is opened for a limited period check the official RRB website regularly for any such notice specific to CEN 02/2026, since this has not been separately confirmed at the time of writing.
  • Do not rely solely on SMS/email alerts log in directly to the official portal to confirm your status.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email ID active, since all further communication (exam city slip, admit card, results) will be sent to the same details.
  • Rely only on the official RRB regional websites and rrbapply.gov.in for updates; avoid unofficial or lookalike websites claiming to offer application status or admit card links.

National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC), a Joint Venture of the Government of India and the participating State Governments of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, has released two Vacancy Notices for its Namo Bharat Project. Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026 invites applications for Supervisors and Non-Supervisors on contract (regular pay scale) basis, while Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026 invites applications for Operations & Maintenance Staff on direct recruitment basis.

In brief: NCRTC is recruiting for 90 posts combined - 23 posts under Notice No. 33/2026 (contract basis) and 67 posts under Notice No. 32/2026 (direct recruitment basis) - covering Supervisor-I and Junior Maintainer roles in IT, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Civil, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications, Operations, Fitter and RAC trades. Candidates with a relevant diploma, degree, or ITI qualification, aged up to 28 years (relaxable), can apply. Online registration is open from 10.09.2026 to 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs) for both notices. Applications are online only via www.ncrtc.in. Selected candidates will be posted at any NCRTC office, workplace, or project unit.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility is assessed as on the cut-off date, 10.09.2026. Only Full Time Regular Courses are considered; only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible.

Educational Qualification - Notice 33/2026 (Contract Basis)

Post Code Post Essential Qualification
C01–C04 Supervisor-I (IT variants) 3 Years Diploma in Computer Science/IT or BCA/B.Sc. (IT) or B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT/Electronics) or MCA or equivalent (Full Time)
C05 Supervisor-I (Corporate Hospitality) Graduate in Hospitality and Hotel Administration/Hospitality Management/Hotel Management or equivalent (Full Time)
C06 Supervisor-I (Corporate Communications) Graduate and PG Degree/PG Diploma in Mass Communication/Public Relations or equivalent (Full Time)

C08 Supervisor-I (Civil) 3 Years Diploma in Civil Engineering or equivalent (Full Time)

C10 Junior Maintainer (Fitter) ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate in Fitter trade or equivalent (Full Time)

For Post Codes C07 and C08, a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) (Full Time) in the relevant discipline is also permitted in place of the Diploma. For Post Codes C09 and C10, the ITI qualification is mandatory - a higher qualification will not be considered as a substitute.

Educational Qualification - Notice 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment)

Post Code Post Essential Qualification
D01 Supervisor-I (Operations) Any Engineering Degree/Engineering Diploma (Full Time)
D02 Supervisor-I (Electronics) 3 Years Diploma in Electronics Engineering or equivalent (Full Time)
D03 Supervisor-I (Electrical) 3 Years Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent (Full Time)
D04 Supervisor-I (Mechanical) 3 Years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (Full Time)
D05 Supervisor-I (Civil) 3 Years Diploma in Civil Engineering or equivalent (Full Time)
D06 Junior Maintainer (Electrical) ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate in Electrician trade or equivalent (Full Time)
D07 Junior Maintainer (Fitter) ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate in Fitter trade or equivalent (Full Time)
D08 Junior Maintainer (RAC) ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate in Refrigeration & Air-Conditioning trade or equivalent (Full Time)
D09 Junior Maintainer (Electronics) ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate in Electronics Mechanic trade or equivalent (Full Time)

For Post Codes D02 to D05, a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) (Full Time) in the relevant discipline is also permitted in place of the Diploma. For Post Codes D06 to D09, the ITI qualification is mandatory.

All qualifications must be from a UGC-recognised Indian University/Deemed University or an AICTE-approved course from an autonomous Indian institution. Where CGPA/OGPA/CPI or a grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage as per the University/Institute's norms must be indicated in the application.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The maximum age limit for all posts under both notices is 28 years, as on 10.09.2026.

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Ex-Servicemen & Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs) Length of military service + 3 years
PwBD – UR/EWS 10 years
PwBD – OBC (NCL) 13 years
PwBD – SC/ST 15 years

Cumulative relaxation for candidates falling under more than one category is admissible. However, the maximum upper age of any candidate shall not exceed 50 years, including all possible age relaxations. Ex-servicemen relaxation is also capped at a maximum age of 50 years. NCRTC employees who have completed one year of service as on the date of the notice get age relaxation to the extent of completed years of service, plus relaxation in the Full-Time qualification requirement.

Candidates from SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD categories who apply against unreserved posts will not get the benefit of age relaxation or relaxed qualifying marks at any stage of the process.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Salary

Grade/Level Pay Scale Initial Basic Pay
Supervisor-I (S1) ₹37,000 – ₹1,15,000 ₹37,000
Junior Maintainer (NS3) ₹18,250 – ₹59,200 ₹18,250

In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will receive Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Perks and Allowances under the Cafeteria Approach, plus other benefits as per extant Company Rules.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • UR, OBC (NCL), EWS and Ex-Servicemen category candidates: ₹500 (non-refundable), exclusive of transaction processing charges and GST.
  • SC, ST and PwBD category candidates: No fee.
  • Fee once paid, including transaction charges and GST, is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must pay the application fee separately for each post.
  • Payment modes: Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection under both notices follows a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Medical Fitness Test.

  • The CBT will have 100 questions for 100 marks; each correct answer carries 1 mark, and there is no negative marking for wrong answers.
  • Duration of the CBT is 90 minutes, available in Hindi or English (candidate's choice).
  • Minimum qualifying percentage: 60% for UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS; 50% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen. Final selection is on merit basis beyond the qualifying marks.
  • Candidates give a preference of 5 cities for their Test Centre; no change is permitted later. Test Centre options include Delhi-NCR, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kanpur, Agra, Vadodara, Indore, Thane, Pune, Guwahati, Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Cuttack, Harohalli, Jaipur, and Patiala.
  • Candidates applying for multiple posts should note that CBTs for different posts may clash in date/time - a candidate can appear in the CBT for one post only in such cases.

Medical Examination Standards

Notice Post Codes Medical Standard
33/2026 C01–C06 C-1 standard
33/2026 C07–C08 A-3 standard
33/2026 C09–C10 B-1 standard
32/2026 D01–D05 A-3 standard
32/2026 D06–D09 B-1 standard

Medical standards follow the Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM). Lasik surgery or any form of radial keratotomy for vision correction is not permitted. Expenses for the first medical examination are borne by NCRTC; a second/re-examination, if required, is at the candidate's own expense.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Surety Bond & Employment Terms

Notice Category & Post Code Bond Amount Minimum Service Period
33/2026 Supervisor (C01–C08) ₹4,00,000 3 years
33/2026 Non-Supervisor (C09–C10) ₹3,00,000 3 years
32/2026 Supervisor (D01–D05) ₹4,00,000 3 years
32/2026 Non-Supervisor (D06–D09) ₹3,00,000 3 years

Under Notice 33/2026, the term of contract is 5 years from the date of appointment; these posts are purely on contract basis and do not confer any right to regularization. Under Notice 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment), selected candidates undergo a probation period of 2 years as per Company policy. In both cases, a one-month prior notice is required on either side before resignation/termination, and selected candidates will undergo on-the-job training of a duration decided by NCRTC.

How to Apply for NCRTC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the NCRTC website, www.ncrtc.in, and click on the "Career" link.
  2. Open the relevant recruitment notification - "Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026" or "Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026" - depending on the post you wish to apply for.
  3. Go through the eligibility, age criteria, and other conditions carefully before proceeding.
  4. Register first; on successful registration, an application number/login ID and password will be generated and sent to your email and mobile number.
  5. From 10.09.2026 onward, log in and fill the application form with all details (age, personal details, educational qualification, etc.).
  6. Upload a recent passport-size colour photo (100–200 KB, JPG/JPEG), a recent scanned signature (80–150 KB, JPG/JPEG), and category/caste certificates plus educational and other certificates (100–1000 KB, JPG/JPEG/PDF).
  7. Preview the application form carefully - once submitted, it cannot be edited.
  8. Complete the fee payment (if applicable) via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking; only after successful payment will a payment acknowledgment with a unique application number be generated.
  9. Submit the application before 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs); it is advised to apply at least two days before the closing date to avoid transaction failures.

NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Applicants must ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria on the specified dates; candidature found ineligible at any stage - even after appointment - will be cancelled/terminated.
  • Selection by NCRTC does not confer any right to appointment.
  • Caste, Ex-Servicemen and EWS certificates must be in the formats prescribed by the Government of India; no other format is acceptable. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to Government directives/litigation outcomes.
  • Request for change of mailing address, email address, or mobile number will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Delhi only.
  • Candidates must keep a sufficient number of the same photograph used in the application in reserve for future use.
  • Admit cards must be downloaded only from www.ncrtc.in; NCRTC is not responsible for information posted on any other website.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • Bringing a mobile phone or communication device into the examination hall is deemed misconduct and may lead to immediate expulsion.
  • NCRTC reserves the right to call or not call any/all candidates, or to cancel/postpone the process, due to administrative reasons.
  • Candidates should refer only to the advertisement on the NCRTC website or Employment News; in case of any discrepancy, the content on www.ncrtc.in will prevail.

How to Download TG TET Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official TG TET website at tgtet.aptonline.in (or schooledu.telangana.gov.in).
